articles.title: Getting started
articles.summary: Display panel, admin unlock, and bottom tabs

sections.heading: Two panels
paragraphs: Kalaban is an offline shop manager. The landing screen is the customer display for fast price lookup. Admin opens with a PIN (or the owner's fingerprint).
steps: Tap admin unlock and enter the PIN
On first use, set the owner PIN once
Use the five bottom tabs: Dashboard, Products, Sales, Reports, Manage
tips: With no extra users, the experience stays single-owner like before
Signing out returns you to the display panel

sections.heading: Today at a glance
paragraphs: The dashboard summarizes today and month sales, low stock, thin margins, and overdue chores such as backups or outdated prices.
steps: Tap cards to jump into reports or products
Work through alerts one by one
Use quick actions for a new sale or import
tips: If a recalculation banner appears after a dollar-rate change, preview first, then apply

articles.title: Products
articles.summary: Create, edit, archive, search, and bulk actions

sections.heading: List and detail
paragraphs: The products tab supports search, filters, sorting, and multi-select. Product detail shows a step-by-step price breakdown and history.
steps: Create a product and attach a camera or gallery image
Sold products stay editable; purchase dollar rate is kept unless purchase price changes
Bulk delete skips items that already have sales
tips: Prefer archive over delete when you might need the item later
Duplicate is fastest for close variants

sections.heading: Structure
paragraphs: Categories and units are independent entities. Custom attributes live on products; numeric ones are available in formulas as attr_<key>.
steps: Create categories/units from Manage
Define attributes with a stable key
Fill attribute values on each product
tips: Keep attribute keys short so formulas stay readable

articles.title: Pricing rules
articles.summary: Dollar link, extras, methods, rounding, bounds

sections.heading: Version 3 engine
paragraphs: Full cost = purchase × dollar ratio + transport + packaging + other, then overhead. Methods: auto (legacy dollar rule), formula, markup, margin, fixed profit, manual. With no active formula, results match the old rule.
Markup adds on cost; margin is profit as a share of sell price. Cash and credit counter prices are derived from the same base.
steps: Set dollar rate and percents in pricing rules
Pick each product's method and min/max bounds
Enable global or step rounding (for example 1000)
tips: Saving the dollar rate no longer silently rewrites every price; you get a review prompt
Persian digits are accepted in numeric fields

articles.title: Formulas
articles.summary: Safe pricing language with versions and tests

sections.heading: Author and test
paragraphs: Formulas never execute code; they are a bounded math language. Priority, scope (all or one category), and an optional condition choose which formula applies.
steps: Create a formula and build the expression from the palette
Test it on a sample product
Activate it and revert versions if needed
tips: Key variables: cost, full_cost, rate, ratio, overhead_pct, manager_pct, profit_pct, tax_pct, min_price, max_price, attr_<key>
Functions: min max abs round ceil floor roundto clamp pct addpct subpct margin if
Persian digits and × ÷ are accepted

sections.heading: Change prices safely
paragraphs: Operations: recalculate, percent, amount, factor, set price. Always preview; conflicts are reported. You can schedule for later or roll back from history.
steps: Choose the scope
Preview impact including stock profit
Apply now or schedule
tips: After a dollar-rate change, recalculate through this flow
Rollback may conflict with newer prices

sections.heading: Recording a sale
paragraphs: Multi-line carts use the decimal pricing engine and quantity-tier discounts. Each line stores cost, tax, and discount at sale time. Credits support balances, partial payments, zeroing with a reason, and system reminders.
steps: Search and add products
Set settlement due days when needed
Record payments later from sale details
tips: Sale-price edits follow role permission
Warnings appear below minimum or break-even

articles.title: Reports
articles.summary: Sales, pricing analysis, and price changes

sections.heading: Three views
paragraphs: Sales shows range totals and profit. Pricing analysis flags thin margins or missing cost and values stock. Price changes show source and user. CSV export opens cleanly in Excel.
steps: Pick a range
Filter flags and columns
Export CSV when needed
tips: Profit is most accurate for new sales that stored unit cost

sections.heading: File to catalog
paragraphs: Download a template, map columns, preview, and choose duplicate policy (skip / update / create). Error rows can be exported.
steps: Choose a CSV file
Map the title column
Confirm the preview
tips: Align the CSV delimiter setting with your file

sections.heading: CSV with BOM
paragraphs: Product, report, and audit exports are CSV so Excel opens them correctly. Native XLSX/PDF is not implemented.
steps: Export from the relevant screen
Open the file in Excel or Sheets
tips: Keep a product CSV next to your .kalb backup before big changes

sections.heading: Protect shop data
paragraphs: Use quick internal backup or save/restore a .kalb file. Restore asks for confirmation and replaces current data, including the audit log inside the backup.
steps: Backup before installing a new build
Set backup reminder days in notification settings
tips: Never run connectedAndroidTest on a real shop phone; it uninstalls the app

sections.heading: Optional multi-user
paragraphs: Built-in roles: Administrator, Store manager, Cashier, Read-only. After five wrong PINs a temporary lockout starts and escalates. Fingerprint always signs in as the owner.
steps: Create or edit a role with the right permissions
Give cashiers their own PIN
Review logins in the audit log
tips: The owner role is locked and must not be removed

sections.heading: From Manage
paragraphs: Shop profile, number format, pricing rules, stock/profit/credit/schedule alerts, and PIN security live here.
steps: Fill the shop name for the display panel
Enable the alerts you need
Change the owner PIN under security when required
tips: Match customer display price mode (base vs cash) to your shop policy

sections.heading: No restart required
paragraphs: System, light, or dark theme switches without closing the app. Persian is RTL and English is LTR. Visual identity: slate ink, copper, cream.
steps: Switch theme and walk every tab once
Switch language and check text direction
tips: If strings look wrong after a language change, sign out of admin and back in

sections.heading: When something fails
paragraphs: Price not updating: bulk recalculate or the post-dollar review. Formula error: use Test. CSV rejected: check mapping and duplicates. No notification: grant notification permission and relax battery optimizations. Forgotten PIN: there is no cloud reset; recover via backup/restore or a clean device setup.
steps: Check the audit log for the last actions
Take a fresh backup if data integrity is in doubt
tips: WorkManager may delay scheduled jobs on aggressive OEMs
